attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: proposed source-only FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE for one original adult humanoid support theatre Actor; one representative of Shakespeare's three actors, not a finished game asset.
Primary request: A single original adult Elizabethan theatre player, visibly a different person from the previously viewed author-owner reference: a clean-shaven man about 30 with a full head of short auburn curls, a lively broad expressive face, straight nose, warm alert eyes and a restrained friendly expression. A low plain burgundy cloth cap sits over the curls. Muted amber fitted doublet with simple stitched seams, modest cloth buttons and short hip tabs; burgundy fitted hose, dark brown soft leather shoes, small cream pleated ruff and narrow cream cuffs. Practical working player's costume, restrained decoration.
Reference roles: Previously viewed Shakespeare image is ONLY a quality/cohort/palette reference. Do not copy his face, receding hair, moustache, goatee, elaborate black costume, cloak, book or quill. Previously viewed Medusa image is ONLY the benchmark for polished sculptural material rendering, anatomy and fine detail, with none of her identity, costume, props or base perspective.
Scene/backdrop: Uniform plain charcoal background, isolated figure and pedestal only. No scenery, floor plane, ground cast shadow, VFX, text, typography, labels or UI.
Style/medium: Premium polished realistically stylized 3D collectible character design reference, finely sculpted face, hands and cloth, believable adult anatomy, crisp material separation and readable silhouette. Original design, no real actor likeness, commercial portrait, commercial scan, franchise key art or copied costume.
Pose and hands: Strictly square FRONT neutral relaxed stance, head and torso and hips facing directly forward, level shoulders, eyes straight at viewer. Both elbows gently bent and separated from the torso so charcoal background gaps remain around both arms. Both hands fully inside the frame and readable with natural fingers. His anatomical LEFT hand, on the viewer's RIGHT, holds ONE small plain cream theatrical half-mask down BESIDE his body, away from his hip and thigh; hold the mask at its outer edge with a visible natural grip. Mask has eye openings and a short nose, no feathers, no lettering and no stick. His anatomical RIGHT hand, on the viewer's LEFT, is relaxed, gently open and EMPTY, with clearly separated natural fingers. No arm across the torso. Legs modestly apart with a clear background gap between them.
Composition/framing: One centered full figure in portrait 2:3 composition, strict FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC elevation, zero three-quarter turn, no camera tilt, no foreshortening or perspective. Entire cap, hair, shoes, hands, mask and pedestal visible. Exactly 6 percent clear top margin above the cap; pedestal bottom at 90 percent of image height, leaving 10 percent plain charcoal below. Generous clear side margins.
Pedestal: ONE round dark stone pedestal made of exactly TWO stacked shallow circular discs. Show it EXACTLY EDGE-ON in this orthographic elevation, as two straight horizontal dark stone bands with a single separation seam. Absolutely NO visible upper surface or elliptical top lip on either disc. No second pedestal, ornaments, labels, steps, ground or scenic elements.
Lighting/color/materials: Soft balanced neutral studio lighting that clearly resolves the face and both hands; subtle warm highlights on amber wool and leather, burgundy cloth, cream linen ruff, realistic skin and dark stone. Muted theatre palette with enough contrast against charcoal.
Constraints: One adult humanoid only. Clean original identity. Mask in actor's LEFT hand only; RIGHT hand empty. No weapons, book, scroll, quill, cape, jewellery, elaborate embroidery, additional masks, text, UI or effects. Preserve the specified front elevation and all framing margins.

Left hand is viewer-right holding the one plain cream half-mask beside the body with visible fingers. Right hand is viewer-left, relaxed and empty. Keep charcoal gaps around arms and between legs. ONE round stone pedestal made of exactly TWO stacked shallow discs, exactly edge-on: only two straight horizontal stone bands with one separating seam and absolutely NO visible top surface or elliptical top lip.
Change ONLY the framing as specified. Do not redesign the person or costume, do not add or remove fingers, props or objects. No floor, cast ground shadow, scenery, VFX, text, typography, labels, UI or watermark.
